prompt: What is the average number of units per order in each channel? Use the sales table, which has one row per order line, with the order's order_id and channel on every line; an order's units are the sum of its lines' units. Return channel and avg_units, one row per channel. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT channel, AVG(units) AS avg_units
FROM sales
GROUP BY channel

WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT order_id, channel, COUNT(*) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel, AVG(units) AS avg_units
FROM order_units
GROUP BY channel

WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT order_id, channel, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, channel
)
SELECT channel, AVG(units) AS avg_units
FROM order_units
GROUP BY channel

WITH order_units AS (
  SELECT channel, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, AVG(units) AS avg_units
FROM order_units
GROUP BY channel
